summary: Round-2 用戶管理 + 積分管理 verified end-to-end. 15 pytest cases run against the live preview (14 pass, 1 skipped as expected). Full points-on-order integration validated via a real create-order → pay-wallet flow for tester+clerk_test (USD$5.38 order → delta=5 points, source=order, idempotent on re-POST, user_log rows '創建訂單' and '訂單付款' written). All 6 new admin pages render on the preview under /admin: levels-admin (4 seeded tiers 普通/白銀/黃金/鑽石 with member_count), tags-admin (grid + CRUD + assign), assets-admin (summary + rows), blacklist-admin (ban+reason→list→unban), userlogs-admin (type tabs + search), points-admin (rules form + ledger tab, config load/save roundtrip). Members list enriched: level{name,color,discount_percent}, points (int), tags (list) all present. Member detail returns points, tags, level.discount_percent and point_transactions. Ban now stores ban_reason + banned_at and unban $unsets them. ONE CRITICAL BACKEND BUG FOUND in /api/admin/members/{uid}/points/adjust (admin_api.py L517).

critical.issue: Returns 404 '會員不存在' for any user who exists in the users collection but has NO 'points' field yet. Root cause: `await db.users.find_one({'user_id': uid}, {'_id':0,'points':1})` returns `{}` (empty dict → falsy) when the user doc lacks a 'points' field, so `if not u` raises 404. Reproduction: before any order payment awards points, GET /api/admin/members/<tester_uid> returns points=0 fine (member detail does find_one without projection), but POST /points/adjust fails. After one paid order has set u.points, the adjust endpoint starts working. Fix: either remove the projection, or query without the projection: `u = await db.users.find_one({'user_id': uid}, {'_id':0})` or check with explicit `is None`.

action_items: FIX HIGH: admin_api.py L517 — projection `{'_id':0,'points':1}` collapses to `{}` when the user has no points field yet, causing `if not u` to raise 404. Change to `u = await db.users.find_one({'user_id': uid}, {'_id':0})` (or `if u is None`). Without this fix, 積分調整 is broken for every member who has never earned/received points — i.e. every brand-new member in the admin UI.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.py:517 projection-vs-truthiness bug (see above). Same pattern should be audited elsewhere in admin_api.py — any `find_one(..., {_id:0, X:1})` followed by `if not u` is unsafe when field X is optional.

server.py:1402 only logs 創建訂單 after /api/orders; the admin confirm path (admin /pay, /admin/orders/{id}/confirm) also awards points but there is no corresponding log_user hook on reject/complete beyond notify_user — consider adding log_user rows for 'order' type on complete and reject to make 用戶日誌 reflect the full lifecycle.

admin_api.py:410 /member-assets returns name from profile.name || users.name, but users doc inserted via phone/email auth often omits both and uses profile.name alone — mostly ok, just worth noting that the 'name' column may be empty for many legacy users.

admin_api.py:333 _levels() counts members by iterating all order aggregations into Python; fine for current volume but should be converted to a $lookup/$bucket pipeline if the orders collection grows past 100k.
admin_api.py:378 user-tags list fires one count_documents per tag in a loop — O(N) extra queries; batch with an $unwind + $group pipeline for larger tag sets.

server.py:862 award_points idempotency depends on (user_id, source, ref) — good. But the point_transactions collection has no unique index on that triple; concurrent duplicate webhooks could still race between the find_one check and the insert. Add a partial unique index on {user_id:1, source:1, ref:1} where ref != ''.

admin_api.py:48 DEFAULT_LEVELS is seeded on first GET but duplicate inserts could still happen if two admins hit GET simultaneously (no upsert / unique index). Add unique index on member_levels.name or seed in a startup hook.

rca of the issue: RCA for /points/adjust 404: in admin_api.py admin_points_adjust (L517), the fetch is `u = await db.users.find_one({'user_id': uid}, {'_id': 0, 'points': 1})`. Motor returns `{}` (not None) when the document matches the filter but has none of the projected fields. The next line `if not u: raise 404` therefore fires on every user whose doc has not yet acquired a 'points' field (which is almost every member before their first paid order or admin adjust). Mitigation: drop the projection or use `u is None`.
